assumption: The recorded ordinary failure begins with the missing NTDLL extension fetch; the SEH cycle is subsequent.
basis: previous System WNF ordinary observer logs
dependent-result: Correct the observed image ownership omission; do not infer ordinary completion or SEH recovery from turn counts
stress-test: Unchanged smoke and whoami observer with non-test final core.
falsification-probe: The same initial fetch remains unmapped, or an earlier failing service is observed.
status: revised: final selected-image bootstrap stops earlier at NtQuerySystemTime; missing-page ownership is verified by focused/native leaf controls, not by a completed ordinary run

assumption: A selected extension has the lifetime and allocation identity of its full image view.
dependent-result: One allocation owns original image and extension; query metadata is removed on release.
stress-test: Partial views, interior unmap, changed protection, overflow and short reservation.
falsification-probe: Independent extension allocation, protection mutation, or surviving extension after unmap.

assumption: An image rebase transformation is admissible only when two concurrently held native views normalize identically.
dependent-result: The kernel-adjusted guard bytes are retained separately from the ordinary mapping template.
stress-test: Different live bases, changed byte, duplicate base, changed metadata, unsupported relocation.
falsification-probe: Normalized bytes/page policy/extensions disagree or the flagged header differs from the actual map base.
status: retained as a runtime admission condition; confirmed on the captured images

assumption: Compatibility page behavior must follow the kernel-reported native machine rather than the build target.
dependent-result: Compatibility templates retain ordinary geometry when LARGE_PAGES is requested; native templates preserve their large-page mapping rule.
stress-test: Native, x64 compatibility, x86 and x86-LAA callers; combined large/rebase flags; independent IsWow64Process2 check.
falsification-probe: Recorded native-machine identity or mapped protections disagree with the selected policy.
status: confirmed on kernel 10.0.29683.1000; other kernel behavior is not proved by this capture

assumption: Only the exact selected installed NTDLL may use the kernel snapshot for initial bootstrap.
dependent-result: Supplied DLLs keep their existing policy; selected NTDLL uses the preferred image and extension range together.
stress-test: Mismatched image identity, occupied range, supplied basename and absent extension.
falsification-probe: An unrelated supplied path acquires native bootstrap policy or a conflicting range silently relocates.
status: confirmed by focused and final subsystem tests; ordinary programs remain incomplete at NtQuerySystemTime
